column1: # ci/fork-upstreams.tsv -- the real upstream of each idesign0 fork submodule, for THIS branch.
# update_forked_submodules.sh only touches a submodule that has an `upstream` git remote.
# That remote lives in .git/modules/<path>/config, which is never committed, so it exists
# only on a developer machine. In CI every submodule is a fresh clone with just `origin`,
# which is why the updater reported "Skipped (N) -- no upstream remote" and had never
# updated anything there. This file is the missing record; scripts/add_upstream_remotes.sh
# reads it and adds the remote.
# Generated from `gh api repos/idesign0/<repo> --jq .parent.clone_url` -- GitHub's own
# record of what each fork was forked from. The two entries marked "verified by shared
# history" are repos GitHub reports no parent for (created with `gh repo create` + push);
# their upstream was confirmed by finding a commit shared with the candidate, not guessed.
# Paths in ci/fork-no-autoupdate.txt are skipped regardless of what is listed here.
